## Security Audit Report — Full Codebase

**Assessed:** 2026-02-06 | **Branch:** `deployment-for-testing-production-1`

---

### CRITICAL (3 findings)

| # | Finding | File | Detail |
|---|---------|------|--------|
| C1 | **Unauthenticated PII exposure via `get-candidate-applications`** | `src/app/api/get-candidate-applications/route.ts` | Returns full candidate data (passport URLs, phone numbers, DOB, CV URLs, interview links) to anyone providing a valid email. No auth, no origin validation. |
| C2 | **Unauthenticated data leak via `check-candidate`** | `src/app/api/check-candidate/route.ts` | Uses `...data` spread — exposes entire Firestore document (mass assignment) to unauthenticated callers. No origin validation. |
| C3 | **Firestore `candidates` collection: `allow create: if true` with zero field validation** | `firestore.rules` (line 12) | Any unauthenticated user can create documents with any fields/values including admin-only fields (`score`, `status`, `scoreAnalysis`). No size, type, or field constraints. |

---

### HIGH (10 findings)

| # | Finding | File | Detail |
|---|---------|------|--------|
| H1 | **Google OAuth `/connect` endpoint has no admin auth** | `src/app/api/google-auth/connect/route.ts` | Publicly accessible — anyone can trigger the OAuth flow and potentially overwrite stored tokens at `settings/google_auth_tokens`. |
| H2 | **Google OAuth `/status` endpoint has no admin auth** | `src/app/api/google-auth/status/route.ts` | Returns connected Google account email to unauthenticated users. |
| H3 | **Google OAuth `/callback` has no admin identity verification** | `src/app/api/google-auth/callback/route.ts` | Validates state parameter but doesn't verify the user is admin before storing OAuth tokens. |
| H4 | **CSRF token store is in-memory — incompatible with serverless** | `src/lib/csrf.ts` (line 12) | `tokenStore = new Map()` — on Vercel, different function invocations won't share state. CSRF tokens generated by one instance are invalid on another. |
| H5 | **OAuth state store is in-memory — same serverless problem** | `src/lib/googleOAuth.ts` (line 22) | `oauthStates = new Map()` — generate-URL and callback may execute on different instances, causing state validation to always fail. |
| H6 | **Storage rules allow unauthenticated file uploads** | `storage.rules` (lines 7-15) | `candidate_files/` write rule has no `request.auth` check. Anyone can upload 10MB files. `contentType` is spoofable. Enables storage cost attacks. |
| H7 | **Client-side direct Firestore writes for candidate submissions** | `src/hooks/useCandidateForm.ts` (line 872) | `addDoc(collection(db, 'candidates'), {...})` — bypasses all server-side validation, rate limiting, and sanitization. Only guard is the permissive Firestore rule (C3). |
| H8 | **Encryption key fallback uses predictable derivation + hardcoded salt** | `src/lib/tokenEncryption.ts` (lines 22-38) | Dev fallback uses `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` or `'development-secret-key'` with literal salt `'salt'`. Even the production path uses `'salt'` as scrypt salt (line 38). |
| H9 | **Admin URL exposed in public sitemap** | `src/app/sitemap.ts` (line 32) | `/admin-dashboard-secret` is listed in `sitemap.xml`, defeating any obscurity benefit. Also listed in `robots.txt` disallow (which advertises it). |
| H10 | **CSP allows `'unsafe-inline'` for `script-src` in production** | `src/middleware.ts` (lines 42-44) and `next.config.ts` (lines 36-37) | Neutralizes XSS prevention benefit of CSP entirely. |

### MEDIUM (16 findings)

| # | Finding | File | Detail |
|---|---------|------|--------|
| M1 | **Missing origin validation on 4 public POST endpoints** | `verify-email/route.ts`, `validate-phone/route.ts`, `check-candidate/route.ts`, `get-candidate-applications/route.ts` | No `validateOrigin()` — vulnerable to cross-site request forgery. `check-duplicate` and `send-confirmation-email` already use it. |
| M2 | **Duplicate security headers — CSP defined in two places** | `next.config.ts` (lines 30-88) + `src/middleware.ts` (lines 36-82) | Can produce conflicting headers. Static assets get `next.config.ts` headers; middleware-matched routes get middleware headers. Changes must be made in two places. |
| M3 | **`update-candidate` — `candidateId` not validated via schema** | `src/app/api/update-candidate/route.ts` (lines 20-22) | Extracted raw from body without length/format validation. Could receive very long strings or special chars. |
| M4 | **Jobs DELETE — `jobId` from query params not validated** | `src/app/api/jobs/route.ts` (lines 93-97) | No length or regex validation on `jobId`. |
| M5 | **Rate limiter fails open on Redis error** | `src/middleware.ts` (lines 162-165) | If Redis is down, `rateLimitResult = { success: true }` — all requests pass through. |
| M6 | **Hardcoded admin email in Firestore rules** | `firestore.rules` (line 17) | Single email `airopanget@gmail.com` hardcoded; inconsistent with server-side `ADMIN_EMAILS` env var supporting multiple admins. |
| M7 | **Admin dashboard has no server-side auth guard** | `src/hooks/useDashboard.ts` | `'use client'` component with client-only redirect. Page HTML/JS bundle is served to all users before redirect fires. |
| M8 | **Redis keepalive auth is optional** | `src/app/api/redis-keepalive/route.ts` (lines 27-34) | If `REDIS_KEEPALIVE_SECRET` not set, endpoint is fully open. Returns Redis connection status (reconnaissance). |
| M9 | **OAuth callback redirect not validated against allowlist** | `src/app/api/google-auth/callback/route.ts` (line 10) | `appUrl` from `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` — if misconfigured, redirects to attacker domain. |
| M10 | **Health endpoint exposes `uptime` and `environment`** | `src/app/api/health/route.ts` (lines 6-8) | Server metadata aids attacker reconnaissance. |
| M11 | **HSTS missing `preload` directive** | `next.config.ts` (lines 65-68) + `src/middleware.ts` (line 70) | Cannot be submitted to HSTS preload list. First-time visitors vulnerable to SSL stripping. |
| M12 | **`Math.random()` used in security-adjacent contexts** | `src/lib/utils.ts` (line 144), `src/lib/security-logger.ts` (line 380), `src/lib/requestId.ts` (line 16), `src/lib/fileValidation.ts` (line 171) | Not cryptographically secure. `generateSecureFilename` name is misleading. |
| M13 | **Missing env vars from validation registry** | `src/lib/env-validation.ts` | `TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, `REDIS_KEEPALIVE_SECRET`, `ABSTRACT_PHONE_API_KEY`, `SECURITY_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`, `FALLBACK_ADMIN_EMAIL` — all used in code but not validated at startup. |
| M14 | **Wildcard image hostname** | `next.config.ts` (lines 19-21) | `*.googleusercontent.com` — overly broad. Should be restricted to `lh3.googleusercontent.com`. |
| M15 | **Deprecated `X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block`** | `next.config.ts` (lines 73-76) + `src/middleware.ts` (line 76) | Removed from modern browsers. Can introduce vulnerabilities in older ones. OWASP recommends `0`. |
| M16 | **`validate-phone` double JSON parse in error handler** | `src/app/api/validate-phone/route.ts` (lines 148-161) | Re-reads `request.json()` after body stream already consumed. Will silently fail. |

### LOW (11 findings)

| # | Finding | File | Detail |
|---|---------|------|--------|
| L1 | **`e2e/.auth/` not in `.gitignore` — Firebase API key in git history** | `e2e/.auth/admin-storage-state.json` (line 8) | Real Firebase API key `REDACTED_GOOGLE_API_KEY` committed. Needs rotation + history scrub. |
| L2 | **`sanitizeUrl` returns original string, not sanitized** | `src/lib/sanitize.ts` (lines 48-60) | Checks lowercased version but returns raw `url`. Unicode/encoded bypasses possible. |
| L3 | **Error details for non-500 status codes sent to client in production** | `src/lib/apiResponse.ts` (lines 53-60) | Only 500 errors are sanitized; 400/403/etc. still leak `details`. |
| L4 | **`pretty-quick` in production dependencies** | `package.json` (line 51) | Dev tool in `dependencies` — increases production bundle/attack surface. |
| L5 | **`@types/nodemailer` in production dependencies** | `package.json` (line 35) | Type definitions have no runtime purpose. Should be in `devDependencies`. |
| L6 | **Duplicate Google AI libraries** | `package.json` (lines 32-33) | Both `@google/genai` and `@google/generative-ai` installed. Consolidate to `@google/genai`. |
| L7 | **`text-encoding` deprecated and unused** | `package.json` (line 58) | Not imported anywhere in `src/`. `TextEncoder`/`TextDecoder` are globally available. |
| L8 | **Deprecated `interest-cohort=()` in Permissions-Policy** | `next.config.ts` (lines 82-85) + `src/middleware.ts` (lines 81-84) | FLoC replaced by Topics API. May cause header rejection. |
| L9 | **Placeholder fallback URLs `yourapp.com` in sitemap/robots** | `src/app/sitemap.ts` (line 4), `src/app/robots.ts` (line 4) | If `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` unset, URLs point to domain you don't control. |
| L10 | **`decryptTokenObject` uses unsafe type assertion** | `src/lib/tokenEncryption.ts` (line 119) | `JSON.parse(decrypted) as T` — no runtime shape validation. |
| L11 | **Client-side rate limiting trivially bypassable** | `src/hooks/useAuth.tsx` (lines 19-22) | Stored in `useRef`, resets on page reload. Server-side rate limiting covers this, but it provides a false sense of security. |

### Dependency Vulnerabilities (2)

| # | Package | Version | Issue |
|---|---------|---------|-------|
| D1 | `xlsx` | `0.18.5` | **Prototype Pollution + ReDoS** — last npm version; patched versions only on SheetJS CDN (0.20.3+). |
| D2 | `next` | `15.1.11` | **CVE-2026-23864 (CVSS 7.5)** — DoS via crafted RSC request. Fix: upgrade to `15.1.12`. |

---

### Positive Observations

The codebase has strong security fundamentals that should be preserved:

- Admin API routes consistently use `requireAdminAuth` + `withCsrfProtection`
- Zod schema validation on nearly every endpoint
- Centralized middleware with rate limiting, body size limits, request ID tracking
- `ApiErrors.internal()` sanitizes 500 error details in production
- AES-256-GCM for OAuth token encryption with auth tag verification
- DOMPurify integration via `isomorphic-dompurify`
- Security event logging with comprehensive audit trail
- Firebase Admin SDK properly initialized (no hardcoded credentials)
- `.env*` files properly gitignored
- Default deny in Storage rules for unmatched paths
- Safe URL validation blocking `javascript:`/`data:`/`vbscript:` protocols
- File name sanitization preventing path traversal

---

### Recommended Priority Order

**Immediate (blocks production safety):**
1. C1 + C2 — Add origin validation + strip sensitive fields from public API responses
2. C3 — Add field-level validation to Firestore create rule
3. H6 — Add auth requirement to Storage write rules
4. H7 — Migrate candidate creation to server-side API route
5. H8 — Fix scrypt salt (use random salt, not literal `'salt'`)
6. D2 — Upgrade `next` to `15.1.12`

**This sprint:**
7. H1–H3 — Add `requireAdminAuth` to Google OAuth endpoints
8. H4–H5 — Migrate CSRF + OAuth state storage to Redis (Upstash already configured)
9. H9 — Remove admin path from sitemap, stop advertising in robots.txt
10. H10 — Replace `'unsafe-inline'` with nonce-based CSP
11. M1 — Add `validateOrigin()` to remaining public POST endpoints
12. M2 — Consolidate security headers to one location (middleware)
13. L1 — Gitignore `e2e/.auth/`, rotate exposed API key

**Next sprint:**
14. M3–M4 — Validate `candidateId` and `jobId` via Zod schemas
15. M5 — Fail-closed rate limiting for security-critical endpoints
16. M6 — Replace hardcoded admin email with Firebase custom claims
17. M7 — Add server-side middleware auth guard for admin pages
18. M8 — Make keepalive auth mandatory in production
19. M10–M16 — Remaining medium fixes
20. L2–L11 — Low-severity cleanup
21. D1 — Replace `xlsx` with SheetJS CDN package
22. L4–L7 — Dependency hygiene (move/remove packages)
